name: Flung Into the Fray
game_text:
When you play a minion stacked here, you may exert a companion.
<phase>Regroup</phase>: If no minion is stacked here, spot your <culture>Wraith</culture> minion to stack it here.
<phase>Shadow</phase>: Spot 2 <culture>Wraith</culture> minions to play a <culture>Wraith</culture> minion stacked here as if played from hand.
